objectives.description: Insert DELIVERABLE 2 assertion at the correct insertion point
Parse Identity value off the file, independent of cycle_plan_dispatch_hash
Compare against task_dispatch_seq; defer with explicit reason on disagreement
Treat missing/unparseable Identity line as a disagreement
Upgrade all 8 remaining fake-path test stubs to write real Identity-bearing files (discovered necessity)
Fix Group 18 false identical-dispatch collision (per-call nonce)
Fix G8 budget seq-no-repeat false replay (consume run1's file before run2)
Manual deliberate-perturbation verification of the defer path, then revert

approaches_tried.approach: bare `_idc_identity_seq=$(grep -m1 ... | sed ...)` with no error guard
approaches_tried.reason: under set -euo pipefail, a no-match grep (exit 1) propagates through the pipe (pipefail) and aborts the whole script (exit 2) for every fixture whose stub returns a non-existent /fake/... path -- 53 failures, mostly 'SUT exited 2'. Fixed with `|| _idc_identity_seq=""`.

approaches_tried.approach: leave the other 8 test stubs returning non-existent /fake/... paths unchanged
approaches_tried.reason: DELIVERABLE 2 explicitly treats a missing/unparseable Identity line as a loud disagreement, never a pass -- so every one of those fixtures' dispatches now gets deferred instead of dispatched, breaking ~20 pre-existing assertions across many unrelated groups. Fixed by upgrading all 8 to write real files, mirroring Group 19's own Phase 1 stub.

approaches_tried.approach: upgrade stubs to write real files with uniform minimal content
approaches_tried.reason: Group 18 dispatches the identical candidate/phase twice (run1, run3) with nothing else to vary, so the now-realistic content hashed byte-identical across both and tripped Fix 2's unrelated identical-dispatch halt, suppressing the charge Group 18's own assertion expected. Fixed with a per-call nonce line outside the hash normalizer's strip set.

approaches_tried.approach: leave G8's seq-no-repeat test's two runs with run1's dispatch file never consumed
approaches_tried.reason: run2 is now correctly recognized as an UNCONSUMED DISPATCH REPLAY (this task's fix) and legitimately reuses run1's seq, which the pre-existing assertion mis-reads as 'did not durably increase'. Fixed by removing run1's recorded dispatch file before run2 to simulate real consumption.

notes: Full suite green: 335 passed, 0 failed. shellcheck -S warning on orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh: only the 2 pre-existing, unrelated warnings at lines 1673/1792. Manually verified the DELIVERABLE 2 defer path fires with a readable WARNING and a deferred row when the Identity seq is deliberately wrong (temporary perturbation of Group 19's stub, reverted immediately -- diff confirmed byte-identical to the pre-perturbation file).
